decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Location Plan, 963/01, Heritage Statement and 2 x photographs of the property Received: 11 January 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - Detailed drawings of the proposed rainwater pipe and gutter shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority before the commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.
description: Replacement of existing rainwater pipe and gutter, removal and replacement of render at low level to front facade, removal of bushes and construction of new front steps and balustrade (Application for Listed Building Consent)
